title: UseCase Bracket v2.0 (Lean)
description: Machine-readable SSOT for a use case. Links strategic KPI, influencing KPIs, action codes, governance roles, value driver model, and structured UX layout rules.

id.description: Use case ID. Core: COM-001. Extension tiers (ADR-0004): COM-EXT-001 (cross-industry), COM-IND-R001 (sector-specific; letter after IND- per ADR-0004 sector register).

domain.description: Business domain (Commercial, Finance, Operations, SupplyChain, XD).

owner_role.description: Business accountability role ID (must exist in org_roles.yaml).

steward_role.description: Data/definition accountability role ID (must exist in org_roles.yaml).

status.description: Lifecycle gate (ADR-0004). Absent or 'active' = final: full Golden Thread enforcement (referential integrity, governed evidence grain, org roles are ERRORs). 'draft' = in elaboration: those reference checks are advisory (WARN) so an unfinished use case can be parked without breaking the build, while it is still scanned and inventoried. 'deprecated' = retired. Structural/schema validity is enforced in every state.

strategic_kpi_id.description: Exactly 1 strategic (North Star) KPI ID from KPI catalog.

influencing_kpi_ids.description: Diagnostic lever KPI IDs from KPI catalog.

action_code_ids.description: Subscribed action code IDs from core/action_codes.

supporting_kpi_ids.description: KPI IDs required to calculate strategic/influencing/action KPIs (report BoM). Registry validates bracket completeness via depends_on closure.

impact_direction.description: Whether the strategic KPI should be maximized or minimized.

primary_driver.description: The main influencing KPI ID that drives the strategic KPI.

impact_logic.description: Narrative explaining how the primary driver affects the strategic KPI.

report_canvas.description: Optional canvas size for grid-based report (default 1920×1080). Enables proportional scaling when changed.

decision_question.description: The primary decision question this page answers. Displayed as a banner. Max 80 chars recommended. See Content_Quality_Guide.md §5.

big_idea.description: One-sentence narrative anchor for this page (Knaflic Big Idea). Template: '[Domain] is [on/off] track — [KPI] is [Δ], [momentum].' See Storytelling_Principles.md §2.

template_variant.description: Template variant from core/templates/page_templates/template_manifest.yaml. Determines slot structure and visual contract. Decision tree: see studio/docs/rebuild/PAGE_TYPE_TAXONOMY.md §4.

template_id.description: Grid page template. Auto-resolved from template_variant if not specified. See template_manifest.yaml for variant→template mapping.

annotation_waiver.description: Set true only when the current filter context produces no notable finding and Main_1 annotation is genuinely not applicable. Waives DoD #11. Requires justification in the bracket comments. Authority: Knaflic, Storytelling with Data (2015), p. 173.

visual_type.description: Abstract visual type from Abstract_Visual_Types.md. Connectors translate to tool-native component.

sparkline_field.description: Measure or field name for the sparkline mini-trend in the KPI card (optional).

comparison.description: Reference period for the delta calculation.

status_logic.description: Signal direction: determines whether a positive delta is green or red.

target_value.description: Explicit target value (optional — used when target is a fixed threshold, not a measure).

kpi_ids.description: Multiple KPI IDs for composite visuals.

visual_type.description: Abstract visual type from Abstract_Visual_Types.md. Connectors translate to tool-native component.

slot_id.description: Explicit slot assignment for Overview (when set, overrides heuristic).

category_field.description: Dimension field for the category axis (e.g. dim_org.Region). Used when bar/column visuals need explicit axis binding.

comparison.description: Reference period for the delta calculation on this visual.

status_logic.description: Signal direction for threshold colouring on this visual.

decision_question.description: The primary decision question this detail page answers. Max 80 chars recommended. See Content_Quality_Guide.md §5.

big_idea.description: One-sentence narrative anchor for this page (Knaflic Big Idea). Template depends on page type. See Storytelling_Principles.md §2.

template_variant.description: Template variant from template_manifest.yaml. For detail pages, T4_ActionDecision is standard when action_panel = true.

template_id.description: Grid page template for Detail (300s): investigator = left slicer + focus + support; action_matrix = narrative + matrix.

evidence_grain.description: Grain of the evidence table — must match a governed fact-table grain from core/data_contracts/domains/*.yaml. Placeholder 'transaction_line' is forbidden; refer to internal/evidence_grain_audit_results.md for correct values.

evidence_measures.description: KPI IDs or measure names for Detail_Matrix value columns (optional).

action_panel.description: Whether to show the action panel.

payload_mode.description: How much action code detail to inject.

evidence_pack.description: Relative path to a domain evidence pack YAML (optional supplementary reference material).

primary_kpi_ids.description: KPI IDs surfaced as KPI Cards in the IR compiler output (primary visual layer).

ux_bindings.description: Optional visual bindings (axis, legend, rows, values, sort, topN) per page/slot. Written by UX Layout Editor; do not edit by hand.

measure_folder.description: Custom folder name in Power BI semantic model.

data_contract_ref.description: Path to the related data contract YAML.

prioritization.description: Use case prioritization scoring (RICE-inspired). Helps objectively rank use cases for implementation order.

business_value.description: Expected business impact if this use case is implemented successfully.

implementation_effort.description: Estimated effort to implement (data, tooling, change management).

confidence.description: Confidence level in the estimates (0.0 = speculative, 1.0 = validated).

reach.description: Scope of users/stakeholders who benefit from this use case.

priority_score.description: Composite priority score (1-100). Can be auto-calculated or manually set.

brand.description: Brand override. Only needed for multi-brand companies. Omit to inherit repo_config.yaml showcase_id.

brand_id.description: showcase_id of the brand to use. Must match a directory under showcases/<brand_id>/brand/brand_spec.yaml. Takes precedence over repo_config.yaml showcase_id.

readiness.description: Organizational readiness assessment for this use case. Evaluates whether prerequisites are met before implementation starts.

data_availability.description: Are the required data sources accessible and of sufficient quality?

org_capability.description: Does the organization have the skills and processes to use this use case?

stakeholder_alignment.description: Are business owners and stakeholders committed to acting on insights?

overall_readiness.description: Summary readiness signal. Green = ready to implement, Amber = gaps to close, Red = not ready.

data_protection.description: DSGVO Art. 25 Privacy by Design and by Default — required when any personal data or individually attributable operational data is processed or displayed. See core/templates/page_templates/governance/Data_Protection_Governance.md

personal_data.description: True if the use case processes or displays any personal data (including pseudonymised data, employee-level metrics, individual customer records, or any data where natural persons can be identified directly or indirectly)

personal_data_categories.description: DSGVO Art. 4(1) data categories present. Required when personal_data = true.

legal_basis.description: DSGVO Art. 6(1) legal basis for processing. Required even when personal_data = false (to confirm the assessment was made).

data_minimisation.description: DSGVO Art. 5(1)(c) — describe how data is minimised to what is necessary for the stated analytical purpose

retention_period_days.description: Maximum number of days raw personal data is retained before aggregation or deletion. Required when personal_data = true.

access_restriction.description: Who is authorised to access the report (role-based or row-level security description)

dpia_required.description: DSGVO Art. 35 — Data Protection Impact Assessment required (true when processing is large-scale, systematic, or uses special categories)

ai_generated_output.description: True if the report uses AI-generated narrative (Smart Narrative, Copilot, LLM). When true, the grounding rules in Storytelling_Principles.md §13 are mandatory.

ai_grounding_measure.description: DAX measure or query that grounds the AI narrative output. Required when ai_generated_output = true. Must reference the same filter context as the KPI cards on the same page.

use_case_links.description: Explicit cross-use-case dependency edges. Each entry documents a formal dependency between this UC and another.

use_case_id.description: ID of the linked use case (e.g. FIN-002, COM-003).

link_type.description: The semantic type of the cross-UC relationship.

reason.description: Narrative explaining why this dependency exists and when it activates.

security.description: Security and access control specification for this use case.

role_table.description: Dimension table that drives the RLS filter.

access_column.description: Column in role_table used for row-level filtering.

test_requirement.description: When and how RLS must be audited.
